title: Garlic Butter Spaghetti
steps:
1. Boil spaghetti until al dente, reserve 1 cup pasta water.
2. Melt butter with garlic over low heat until fragrant.
3. Toss pasta with garlic butter, parmesan, and a splash of pasta water.
4. Season with salt, pepper, and parsley.

title: Tomato Basil Penne
steps:
1. Cook penne until al dente.
2. Saute garlic and onion, add chopped tomatoes and simmer 10 minutes.
3. Stir in basil and toss with pasta.
4. Top with parmesan.

title: Chicken Stir Fry
steps:
1. Slice chicken thin and stir fry in oil until browned.
2. Add bell pepper, broccoli, and carrot, stir fry 5 minutes.
3. Add soy sauce, garlic, and ginger, cook 2 more minutes.
4. Serve over rice.

title: Beef and Broccoli
steps:
1. Slice beef thin, marinate in soy sauce for 10 minutes.
2. Sear beef in a hot pan, set aside.
3. Stir fry broccoli and garlic, return beef to pan.
4. Add soy sauce and a splash of broth, toss and serve over rice.

title: Vegetable Fried Rice
steps:
1. Scramble eggs in a hot wok, set aside.
2. Stir fry carrot, onion, and corn.
3. Add cold rice, breaking up clumps, stir fry 3 minutes.
4. Add soy sauce and eggs back in, toss to combine.

title: Shrimp Tacos
steps:
1. Season shrimp with cumin, chili powder, and salt.
2. Saute shrimp in oil until pink, about 4 minutes.
3. Warm tortillas.
4. Fill tortillas with shrimp, cabbage, and a squeeze of lime.

title: Black Bean Tacos
steps:
1. Warm black beans with cumin and chili powder.
2. Mash lightly and season with salt.
3. Warm tortillas.
4. Fill with beans, avocado, and cilantro.

title: Chicken Fajitas
steps:
1. Slice chicken and bell pepper into strips.
2. Saute chicken until browned, add pepper and onion.
3. Season with cumin, chili powder, and paprika.
4. Serve in tortillas with lime.

title: Classic Beef Chili
steps:
1. Brown ground beef with onion and garlic.
2. Add kidney beans, tomato, and spices.
3. Simmer 30 minutes, stirring occasionally.
4. Season to taste and serve.

title: Lentil Soup
steps:
1. Saute onion, carrot, and garlic in oil.
2. Add lentils, broth, and cumin, bring to a boil.
3. Simmer 25 minutes until lentils are soft.
4. Blend partially if a thicker soup is preferred.

title: Creamy Tomato Soup
steps:
1. Saute onion and garlic in butter.
2. Add tomato and broth, simmer 15 minutes.
3. Blend until smooth.
4. Stir in heavy cream and season to taste.

title: Chickpea Curry
steps:
1. Saute onion, garlic, and ginger in oil.
2. Add curry powder and cook 1 minute until fragrant.
3. Add chickpeas, tomato, and coconut milk, simmer 15 minutes.
4. Serve over rice.

title: Butter Chicken
steps:
1. Marinate chicken in yogurt and spices for 10 minutes.
2. Sear chicken, set aside.
3. Saute onion, garlic, ginger, add tomato and simmer.
4. Blend sauce, stir in cream and chicken, simmer 10 minutes.

title: Baked Salmon with Vegetables
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 400F (200C).
2. Toss zucchini and cherry tomatoes with olive oil and salt.
3. Place salmon and vegetables on a sheet pan.
4. Bake 15-18 minutes until salmon flakes easily.

title: Pan Seared White Fish with Greens
steps:
1. Season fish with salt and pepper.
2. Sear in butter 3 minutes per side.
3. Wilt spinach in the same pan with garlic.
4. Serve fish over greens with a squeeze of lemon.

title: Greek Salad
steps:
1. Chop cucumber, tomato, and red onion.
2. Combine with feta and olives.
3. Dress with olive oil, lemon juice, and oregano.
4. Toss and serve.

title: Caprese Salad
steps:
1. Slice tomato and mozzarella.
2. Layer alternating slices on a plate.
3. Tuck basil leaves between slices.
4. Drizzle with olive oil and season with salt and pepper.

title: Egg Fried Rice
steps:
1. Scramble eggs, set aside.
2. Stir fry cold rice in oil until heated through.
3. Add soy sauce and eggs, toss together.
4. Garnish with scallion if available.

title: Vegetable Omelette
steps:
1. Whisk eggs with salt and pepper.
2. Saute bell pepper, onion, and mushroom until soft.
3. Pour eggs over vegetables in a hot pan.
4. Fold once set and top with cheddar.

title: Chicken Caesar Salad
steps:
1. Season and sear chicken breast, slice thin.
2. Toss lettuce with parmesan and dressing of choice.
3. Top with sliced chicken.
4. Finish with black pepper and extra parmesan.

title: Pulled Pork Sandwich
steps:
1. Season pork with paprika, salt, and pepper.
2. Slow cook with a little broth until falling apart, about 3 hours.
3. Shred pork with two forks.
4. Pile onto bread with cabbage slaw.

title: Bacon and Egg Breakfast Hash
steps:
1. Cook bacon until crisp, remove and chop.
2. Cube and pan fry potato in bacon fat until golden.
3. Add onion and cook until soft.
4. Top with fried eggs and bacon.

title: Roasted Vegetable Quinoa Bowl
steps:
1. Roast sweet potato, broccoli, and chickpeas with olive oil at 425F (220C) for 25 minutes.
2. Cook quinoa according to package directions.
3. Combine quinoa and roasted vegetables in a bowl.
4. Drizzle with lemon juice and season to taste.

title: Peanut Noodles
steps:
1. Cook spaghetti until al dente.
2. Whisk peanut butter, soy sauce, and a splash of water into a sauce.
3. Toss noodles with sauce and shredded carrot.
4. Garnish with cilantro.

title: Mushroom Risotto
steps:
1. Saute mushroom in butter, set aside.
2. Saute onion and garlic, add rice and toast 1 minute.
3. Add broth a ladle at a time, stirring until absorbed.
4. Stir in mushroom and parmesan before serving.

title: Zucchini and Chickpea Stew
steps:
1. Saute onion and garlic in olive oil.
2. Add zucchini, tomato, and chickpeas.
3. Simmer 20 minutes with cumin and paprika.
4. Season to taste and serve with bread.

title: Cheesy Baked Cauliflower
steps:
1. Steam or par-boil cauliflower florets until just tender.
2. Place in a baking dish and top with cheddar.
3. Bake at 400F (200C) for 15 minutes until bubbly.
4. Season with salt and pepper before serving.

title: Turkey Style Ground Beef Lettuce Wraps
steps:
1. Brown ground beef with garlic and ginger.
2. Stir in soy sauce and a pinch of chili flakes.
3. Spoon mixture into lettuce leaves.
4. Top with shredded carrot and serve.

title: Banana Oat Pancakes
steps:
1. Mash banana and whisk with eggs and milk.
2. Stir in flour and baking powder until just combined.
3. Cook spoonfuls of batter on a buttered griddle.
4. Flip once bubbles form, cook until golden.

title: Apple Cinnamon Oatmeal
steps:
1. Bring milk to a simmer.
2. Stir in oats and diced apple.
3. Cook 5 minutes, stirring occasionally.
4. Sweeten with honey and dust with cinnamon.

title: Avocado Toast with Egg
steps:
1. Toast bread until crisp.
2. Mash avocado with salt, pepper, and lemon juice.
3. Fry or poach an egg.
4. Spread avocado on toast and top with the egg.

title: Chicken Noodle Soup
steps:
1. Saute onion and carrot in a large pot.
2. Add broth and chicken breast, simmer until cooked through.
3. Shred chicken and return to pot.
4. Add spaghetti broken into pieces, cook until tender.

title: Kale and White Bean Soup
steps:
1. Saute garlic and onion in olive oil.
2. Add broth and kidney beans, simmer 10 minutes.
3. Stir in kale and cook until wilted.
4. Season with salt, pepper, and a squeeze of lemon.

title: Stuffed Bell Peppers
steps:
1. Cook rice and mix with browned ground beef, onion, and garlic.
2. Stuff mixture into halved bell peppers.
3. Top with cheddar.
4. Bake at 375F (190C) for 25 minutes.

title: Shakshuka
steps:
1. Saute onion, garlic, and bell pepper in olive oil.
2. Add tomato and paprika, simmer 10 minutes.
3. Make wells in the sauce and crack eggs into them.
4. Cover and cook until eggs are just set.

title: Cucumber Yogurt Salad
steps:
1. Dice cucumber and combine with greek yogurt.
2. Add minced garlic and a drizzle of olive oil.
3. Season with salt and pepper.
4. Chill before serving.

title: Sweet Potato Black Bean Bowl
steps:
1. Roast cubed sweet potato with cumin and chili powder at 400F (200C) for 25 minutes.
2. Warm black beans.
3. Combine sweet potato and beans in a bowl.
4. Top with avocado and lime juice.

title: Honey Garlic Salmon
steps:
1. Whisk honey, soy sauce, and minced garlic into a glaze.
2. Sear salmon skin side down, flip.
3. Pour glaze over salmon and simmer 2 minutes.
4. Serve over rice with the pan sauce.

title: Pork Chop with Roasted Potatoes
steps:
1. Season pork chops with paprika, salt, and pepper.
2. Roast potato wedges with olive oil at 425F (220C) for 20 minutes.
3. Sear pork chops 4 minutes per side.
4. Rest pork chops before serving with potatoes.

title: Broccoli Cheddar Soup
steps:
1. Saute onion in butter, add broth and broccoli.
2. Simmer until broccoli is tender, about 10 minutes.
3. Blend partially for a chunky texture.
4. Stir in cheddar and heavy cream until melted.
